source_note: The logs cover the Wave 26 working tree plus the explicitly recorded fixes. The base commit identifies the checkout, not a claim that uncommitted Wave 26 code existed in that commit.

scope.suite_count_definition: Suite counts refer to test files. The node:test reporter lists zero describe-style suites because these files declare top-level tests.

reconciliation_method: Parse each log only through its first node:test summary, excluding repeated failure diagnostics and appended prose from execution counts.
Map each reported title to a unique top-level test declaration in the selected source files. Stable W-prefixed check IDs reconcile the intentionally updated W0-C02 title.
Retain initial results separately. A targeted rerun changes final status only for checks that it actually executed.
Verify 178 legacy and 9 Wave 26 unique checks, 55 repeated check executions, and 187 final passing distinct checks. This is not a claim of one clean 187-check run.
Record SHA-256 hashes of all six evidence logs so the summary can be matched to the exact reviewed files.

preservation.finding: The 0.23-to-0.26 schema-5 path validates the historical state, clones it, updates only contentVersion/buildVersion and validates again. W26-S01 verifies normalized deep equality of the 0.23 fixture, including all retained slices and queued commands.

original_byte_archive.prior_finding: The archive key existed, but RecoveryKind, RECOVERY_OPTIONS and RECOVERY_KEYS initially did not expose it for recovery export.
original_byte_archive.resolution: The content023 recovery option now exports frontier-lab.content023.original. The original string is archived before primary replacement, is never overwritten by later saves, and an archive failure leaves the primary untouched.

future_field_rejection.finding: The recursive historical-version guard rejects synthetic fields, S1/S2 knowledge and commands, and targeted synthetic recipe evidence before migration and during source-state validation. W26-S09 includes a correctly checksummed synthetic state disguised under a 0.23 header.

strengthened_coverage.description: Added an explicit rejection case for a teacher without inherited transfer rights; the strengthened check passed in the targeted synthetic rerun.

scope_limits: This summary covers the selected automated suites only. Browser workflow, production build and publication are handled separately.
Initial failures remain in the retained logs; final status is reconciled from passing targeted reruns, not from rewriting those logs or claiming a full repository rerun.
